title: SUID bit set on an interpreter/binary
description: auditd records `chmod u+s /usr/bin/find`, a classic local privilege-escalation persistence trick.

events.template:
type=SYSCALL msg=audit(@@audit_ts@@:@@audit_serial@@): arch=c000003e syscall=59 success=yes exit=0 a0=55d6c2a1 a1=55d6c2b0 a2=55d6c2c8 a3=0 items=2 ppid=1987 pid=@@pid@@ auid=1003 uid=0 gid=0 euid=0 suid=0 fsuid=0 egid=0 sgid=0 fsgid=0 tty=pts0 ses=4 comm="chmod" exe="/usr/bin/chmod" key="perm_mod"
type=EXECVE msg=audit(@@audit_ts@@:@@audit_serial@@): argc=3 a0="chmod" a1="u+s" a2="/usr/bin/find"
